author: anon-df5e95db
content: Plan: Replace kbs_init/kbs_insert/kbs_destroy in remove_alleles() with a pure Rust helper that allocates a C-compatible kbitset_t using libc::malloc, sets bits from the &[bool] slice, and frees after bcf_remove_allele_set returns. No FFI calls for bitset operations. Differential test: create records with multiple alleles, remove various combinations, compare results between C (kbs_*) and Rust implementations.
